profile.headline: Senior Software Developer

company.name: Konica Minolta Business Solutions U.S.A., Inc.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Documented, maintained, and developed software for the Aciex  software suite, the companies’ Energy Management System.
Worked on analyzing and documenting the extensive, existing code base.
Documented software and system requirements for new features.
Maintenance and development of the system source code targeting the Windows PC environment.

positions.title: Software Testing Specialist
positions.description:
Created documentation for system testing, verification, and validation. Including documentation for all project development stages: user requirement specifications, test execution reports, validation plans, validation protocols and final reports. Developed an expertise in relevant software workflows and use cases. Leveraged my developed expertise in order to educate other team members and therefore contribute to all other aspects of the project lifecycle.

•	Documented software and system user testing.
•	Created documentation for engineering change orders in cooperation with team members from Quality Engineering.
•	Worked with customer service representatives to troubleshoot and support customer issues.
•	Collaborated with other software vendors for system integration testing.

positions.title: Senior Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Created documents needed for system validations: validation
plans, user requirement specifications, validation protocols and final reports.
- Created specifications detailing software system requirements.
- Created IQ/OQ/PQ documents for validation of automated manufacturing equipment
such as the equipment used to manufacture the Tenderfoot incision product line.
- Created software test plans, testing scripts, and user acceptance testing documents.
- Created documents for validation of Excel spreadsheets used to analyze results of
finished product testing.
- Documented product and process risk assessments.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, documented, and debugged software for HEMOCHRON Response and Signature medical devices that test blood coagulation.
- Worked on software (in VB) for test data record retrieval and storage in Microsoft Jet
database with capability to generate reports using Crystal Reports.
- Created PC based field upgrade software (in C++) to update product firmware.
- Worked on configuration utility software (in VB) for IRMA TRUpoint blood analysis
system.
- Designed and implemented CLSI POCT1A connectivity standard on Signature Elite
medical device.
- Implemented RxDx dosing software on Response medical device.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, documented, and debugged software (in C) for various
real-time embedded firmware products.
- Responsible for modifying existing firmware based on Motorola 68EN302 microprocessor
to support the next generation hardware design.
- Developed project utilizing Motorola 68HC908GP32 micro-controller with remote flash
upgrade capability.
- Responsible for development of project providing an SNMP interface for a cable signal
switch product utilizing a serial RS-485 interface.
- Assisted in interviewing prospective software engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, documented, and debugged software in C/C++ for network
device providing voice over frame relay.
- Under UNIX environment, designed firmware of real-time embedded system product
utilizing Intel i960 microprocessor.
- Worked on objected oriented design (OOD) of various sub-systems including a task
scheduler OS, resource management, and hardware PAL/FPGA loading.
- Worked on software modifications to make above network device compatible with other
existing Timeplex products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, documented, and debugged software (in C) for various real-
time applications.
- Real-time firmware of embedded system products utilizing Philips Signetics 8051,
Motorola 68000 and 68302 microprocessors.
- Worked on Windows applications to control and monitor switching equipment.
- Worked on Windows applications used in conjunction with HP Openview Network Device
Management software.
- Created installation programs using InstallShield to facilitate distribution of Windows
software products mentioned above.

positions.title: Assistant Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software to automate product testing and manually tested
electronic communications equipment to validate firmware and hardware.
- Products tested included: communications switching equipment, ISDN Terminal Adapters
and Fallback Switches.
- Documented testing procedures using Microsoft Word and Excel.
- Assisted in writing software in C for Windows application using Windows SDK API to
automate product regression testing using a PC serial COM port.
- Provided technical support to customers and assisted them with installation, configuration
and troubleshooting of equipment.
